integrity: A self-contained proof and exact standalone exhaustive checker are included. The source-date selection is the verified first arXiv submission of arXiv:0907.4680; no publication or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent Bernoulli edges; connected motifs only; covariance is not independence; historical implicit coverage remains possible, particularly older general moment papers. Full text of Frank (1979) was not available.
title: Connected-motif Palm cancellation and sharp tree-shape covariance phases
